name: Typical School Days
source:
This is a game were you have to go to school and survive this typical school day of yours without getting beaten up by your angry Teacher.

[From [url=https://mr-ding-dong-inc.itch.io/typical-school-days] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你必须去学校并在这个典型的学校日中生存下来，而不被愤怒的老师殴打。

[来自[url=https://mr-ding-dong-inc.itch.io/typical-school-days] itch.io[/url]]
